content.text: [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-digital-products-africa-one-afternoon-fast-track-2|Selling Digital]] a digital product should be a simple transaction. You build something valuable — an ebook, a course, a Notion template, a font family, a preset pack, a beat — and someone pays you for access to it. The file transfers. The transaction [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers|complete]]s. But for millions of creators, the payment layer is where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-tron-usdt-payments-10|COREMERCH guide to everything]] breaks down. Stripe is unavailable. PayPal flags the account. Gumroad holds the payout. The workarounds stop working. What actually works is a sovereign commerce stack: a static storefront on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, automatic payment verification through NOWPayments, and delivery triggered by a webhook the moment the transaction confirms on-chain. No platform intermediary. No payout schedule. No geography filter. The customer owns the storefront code, the order history, the customer list, and the product files. COREMERCH has no access after deployment.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-8. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Automated ebook

Automated ebook delivery after crypto payment refers to the entire process of selling ebooks online without relying on traditional payment platforms. Instead of using services like Gumroad, which charges a steep 10% on sales, creators can utilize NOWPayments, which only charges 0.5%. This significant reduction in transaction fees allows creators to retain more of their earnings, making it a smarter financial choice. This method not only streamlines the purchasing experience for customers but also ensures that creators have full ownership of their digital assets.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The infrastructure enabling automated delivery consists of several key components. First, the digital product is hosted on a platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. When a customer makes a purchase, the payment is processed via NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. Once the payment confirmation is received, an automated system built using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script delivers the ebook directly to the customer. This seamless integration ensures that transactions are secure, efficient, and instantaneous without any dependency on traditional payment gateways.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is primarily designed for digital creators who are unable to use conventional payment platforms due to regional restrictions or high fees. This includes authors selling ebooks, course creators, and artists offering templates or digital assets. By using this architecture, creators can bypass barriers imposed by platforms like Gumroad or PayPal. They retain full control over their sales, data, and product delivery, allowing them to focus on what they do best: creating content.
Automated delivery means no manual intervention after the sale.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The automated delivery architecture is built on a combination of free and low-cost tools. The digital product is stored in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, while orders are tracked using Supabase or Google Sheets. The payment verification happens through NOWPayments, ensuring instant transaction confirmations. Additionally, with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configured, email communications are secure, enhancing trust with customers. Each component is designed to work seamlessly with the others, creating a cohesive and efficient system.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this infrastructure, start by selecting your digital products and hosting them on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up NOWPayments to handle your cryptocurrency transactions. Use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for automated delivery upon payment confirmation. Store your order data in Supabase or Google Sheets to keep track of sales. For those looking for a comprehensive solution, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all the blueprints and templates needed for a successful setup.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Retain more of your earnings with low transaction fees of just 0.5%.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
